title: Master's Simple Storage Terminal
description: Access all your connected storage from one easy-to-use terminal.
body:
# Master's Simple Storage Terminal

Master's Simple Storage Terminal is a lightweight storage management mod for **Minecraft Forge 1.20.1** that lets you manage all of your connected storage from a single terminal.

Instead of opening countless chests to find a single item, simply connect them to a Storage Terminal and browse your entire storage network through one clean and intuitive interface.

Designed to stay simple, fast, and easy to use, the mod focuses on improving vanilla storage without introducing complicated machines, energy systems, or automation.

---

## Features

✔ Connect multiple chests into one storage network

✔ Access every connected inventory from a single terminal

✔ Quickly search through all stored items

✔ Clean and easy-to-use interface

✔ Lightweight and performance friendly

✔ Perfect for survival, multiplayer servers, and modpacks
![Chest terminal gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9c857cf2ddcb3e27a28476d886f0cca011587e7.png)![furnace terminal gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8f5ee003fd77d3486ca6346846cc7ebd7064001.png)


![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cafac0d30f44c69a7e49a3f30199f5020fa0a91d.png)
---

## Why Choose Master's Simple Storage Terminal?

As your world grows, your storage quickly becomes difficult to manage. Large bases often contain dozens—or even hundreds—of chests spread across different rooms.

Master's Simple Storage Terminal gives you one central place to access everything, making storage management faster, cleaner, and far more enjoyable while keeping the vanilla feel intact.

---

## Designed For

* Survival Players
* Multiplayer Servers
* Modpacks
* Large Storage Rooms
* Builders
* Players who prefer simple solutions over complex technology mods

---

## Planned Features

The mod is actively being developed. Future updates may include:

* Improved terminal interface
* More quality-of-life features
* Brewing Stand Storage 

---

## Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.20.1**
* Forge

---
## Why I Created This Mod

While looking for a storage solution for my own worlds, I noticed that most storage mods either rely on complex automation systems or require connecting everything with lots of cables, pipes, or additional blocks.

I wanted something much simpler.

I couldn't find a mod that offered a clean and straightforward storage terminal with this approach, so I decided to create one myself.

Master's Simple Storage Terminal focuses on keeping storage management intuitive and accessible. Simply connect your storage, open the terminal, and access everything from one place—without unnecessary complexity.

If you're looking for a lightweight alternative that stays close to the vanilla experience while making storage much more convenient, this mod is for you.

## Feedback

Found a bug or have an idea for a new feature?

Feedback and suggestions are always welcome! They help improve the mod and shape future updates.

Thank you for downloading **Master's Simple Storage Terminal**.
Enjoy a simpler and more organized storage experience!
